items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: I got six living now and one Eve. Six sisters living and one Eve.

ctx.x: Oh, that's a good size. Ten. Yeah, that's a good size family.
It's a great family. I got six living now and one Eve. Six sisters living and one Eve.
Oh, there's still most of them. Most of them lived in this neighborhood? They lived right back to St. Phil's.
